name: Pension To Widows And Destitute Women-Chandigarh
benefit: Pension Amount To Widows And Destitute Women - ₹1,000/- per month
eligibility_rules: The applicant women's age should be 18-60 years. The applicant should be a resident of UT, Chandigarh for more than 3 years. The applicant's family's annual income should not exceed ₹1,50,000/-
documents_required: Residence proof of three years (Voter Card, Ration Card, Electricity Bill etc).Death certificate of husband
(In case of widow).Aadhar Card. Mobile Number.
how_to_apply: Mode: Online RegistrationStep 1: Applicant has to visit the "e-District" websiteStep 2: Click on the " citizen login" on the home pageStep 3: Now you click on "New User Register here" on the pageStep 4: Fill out the registration form with your - Full Name - Father Name - Date Of Birth - Gender - Mobile No - Email Id - Country - State, e.t.cStep-5: Review the details to ensure accuracy, and then submit registration. Step-6: After successful registration, you may receive a confirmation message on the website or via email, confirming that your registration was successful.
